brief: European EV fast-charging networks: the largest operators by number of high-power chargers, typical pricing per kWh, and expansion plans announced in the last 12 months.

notes: st-2: excluded 1 source(s) published before 2025-07-27 (outside 'last 12 months'): numerama.com
st-4: excluded 1 source(s) published before 2024-12-14 (outside 'last 18 months'): transportenvironment.org

coverage.reason: Covers operator counts, per-kWh pricing and expansions and adds AFIR, but operator ranking by high-power chargers is not answered and several operators lack data.

structure.reason: Follows the expected sections in order with clear headings and a dedicated gaps section, though the policy section is titled differently from the brief's expected label.

faithfulness.reason: Most claims carry dates, sources and credibility scores, and conflicting figures are shown side by side, but some sources are weak and a few claims (e.g. the 180% exceedance and 79% figure) are single-source with no corroboration.

gaps_honesty.reason: The gaps section plainly states missing operator rankings, unresolved Spain and Hungary pricing conflicts, undated EnBW target, and excluded out-of-window sources.

clarity.reason: Concise and readable with confidence labels per section, though the executive summary repeats body content and some paragraphs are dense with inline citations.
